run_validators: run a list of Validator instances and aggregate their ValidationReport results into a single ValidationResult
create_custom_validator: create a custom Validator subclass by implementing the name property and __validate__ method returning a ValidationReport
test_run_validators_all_succeed: test run_validators with multiple successful validators to verify aggregated result is SUCCESS
test_run_validators_one_fails: test run_validators with one failing validator to verify aggregated result is FAILED
test_run_validators_exception_handling: test run_validators with an exception-throwing validator to verify it returns a WARNING report instead of crashing
